patterns.note: Extensive use of a clean, grid-based layout for displaying location details and image galleries, maintaining consistent spacing and alignment.
A monospaced-like sans-serif font is consistently used for all functional text, including navigation, buttons, contact information, and footer links, creating a distinctive, precise aesthetic.
A stark, high-contrast black and white color scheme dominates, with subtle touches of a warm gold/bronze used sparingly for brand accents.
The hero section features a large, multi-line text overlay that scrolls out of view, revealing a full-bleed background image that parallaxes subtly behind foreground content.
Location overview sections are presented as distinct, horizontally-aligned blocks, each containing a brief description, contact details, and a 'Book Your Seat' call to action.

technique_notes: The hero section is built with a large, multi-line text element positioned over a full-bleed background image. As the user scrolls, the text scrolls away at a normal rate, while the background image moves at a slower rate, creating a subtle parallax effect. A global navigation bar transitions from an initial transparent state to a sticky, compact version with a solid background after the user scrolls past the hero.

The site employs a distinctive monospaced-like font for all interactive and informational text elements, such as navigation links, buttons, and detailed contact information, to establish a consistent and precise brand voice.
Image galleries and content blocks are arranged in a clean grid, often with a single image or content item per column, ensuring ample whitespace and clear visual separation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin sans-serif hero text (~4-5x body) contrasts with smaller, uppercase monospaced-like labels and body text, creating a precise, editorial feel.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with all elements and images maintaining crisp, angular corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and content blocks, creating a sense of calm and luxury.

standout: The most distinctive element is the consistent and pervasive use of a monospaced-like font for all functional text, including navigation, buttons, and detailed information, which gives the site a unique, precise, and almost archival aesthetic. This, combined with the stark black and white imagery and minimal color palette, creates a highly refined and editorial feel that elevates the brand beyond a typical restaurant website.
